description: This PHP source file defines the MysqlSource class, which extends BackupSource to handle MySQL database backup operations, including connection setup, stage management, table listing, and SQL statement generation for backup purposes.

classes.name: MysqlSource
classes.description: A class responsible for managing MySQL database backup stages, including connection setup, retrieving table schemas, and generating SQL insert statements for backing up database data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the MysqlSource with the provided database configuration and sets up the connection.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Advances the backup process to the next stage and returns the current stage and associated data.

methods.name: valid
methods.description: Checks if there are remaining backup stages to process.

methods.name: getNextStage
methods.description: Determines the next backup stage based on the current stage.

methods.name: getStageData
methods.description: Retrieves data associated with the specified backup stage.

methods.name: initTableList
methods.description: Fetches the list of table names in the database.

methods.name: setCurrentTable
methods.description: Sets the current table and resets related result pointers for processing.

methods.name: getInsertStatement
methods.description: Generates an SQL insert statement for a batch of rows from the current table.

methods.name: getTableCreateStatement
methods.description: Retrieves the SQL statement to create the specified table.

methods.name: checkError
methods.description: Checks for errors in the database operation and throws exceptions if any.
